message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Search recent (past ~5 years) academic papers, review articles, industry reports, and lab press releases for measured solar cell and module efficiencies. Collect: source citation (URL/DOI), date, device type (single-junction, multi-junction, perovskite, tandem, concentrator, module vs cell), test conditions (AM1.5G, concentration factor, temperature), and the reported efficiency (%). Also extract named theoretical limits cited (e.g., Shockley–Queisser) and their stated values/assumptions. Save a structured summary containing sources and extracted numeric records as research_findings.json.","dependencies":[],"produces":"research_findings.json","consumes":[],"rationale":"gather up-to-date primary evidence and stated theoretical limits","needs_tools":["web_search"]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"data_analyst","description":"Ingest research_findings.json, normalize and validate the numeric efficiency records (unify % formats, label cell vs module, note test conditions). Produce a concise analysis that: (a) identifies current best reported efficiencies by category (lab single-junction, lab multi-junction, commercial module), (b) generates a simple time-series summary of record improvements, and (c) compares measured records to cited theoretical limits (e.g., Shockley–Queisser). Write results, tables, and short charts' descriptions into efficiency_analysis.md (include links back to original sources and a small CSV appendix if helpful).","dependencies":["s1"],"produces":"efficiency_analysis.md","consumes":["research_findings.json"],"rationale":"convert collected sources into validated numeric comparisons and trend evidence","needs_tools":["read_file","terminal"]},{"id":"s3","agent_id":"creative","description":"Draft a clear executive summary final_summary.md (2–4 pages) describing the current state of solar-panel efficiency and where the practical and theoretical ceilings lie. Explain: single-junction detailed-balance ceiling (with value and context), multi-junction/tandem practical limits and recent lab records, gap between lab cell records and commercial module efficiencies, realistic near-term ceilings and long-term theoretical limits, and key uncertainties. Cite efficiency_analysis.md and primary sources, provide a short 'key numbers' box, and give a one-paragraph plain-language conclusion for non-expert readers.","dependencies":["s2"],"produces":"final_summary.md","consumes":["efficiency_analysis.md"],"rationale":"produce a polished, readable summary for the user","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]}]}
